title: Mass drone attack on Moscow grounds flights at region's airports
summary: Over a hundred drones have been shot down en route to the Russian capital, Moscow Mayor Sergey Sobyanin claimed.

title: Czechia could deliver first four L-39 Skyfox jets to Ukraine in 2027, foreign minister says
summary: The L-39 Skyfox, manufactured by Czech company Aero Vodochody, is a subsonic jet primarily designed for military pilot training. It can also carry out light attack, reconnaissance, and aerial patrol missions.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,618,920 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,590 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.

title: 3 injured, dozens evacuated after Russian drone damages Kyiv medical facility in overnight attack
summary: A downed drone caused a fire at a medical facility in the capital's Shevchenkivskyi district in the early morning, partially destroying its second floor, according to Ukraine's State Emergency Service. Seven people in the facility had to be rescued by first responders.

title: US service member accused of attempting to spy for Russia identified, media reports
summary: A U.S. Army officer who was arrested in England for allegedly attempting to pass sensitive information to Russia was identified as Lt. Col. Brandon Tyner on Nov. 12.

title: Volgograd oil refinery, Rostov-on-Don production facility in flames following Ukrainian drone attack
summary: Eyewitness footage from the scene appears to show flames emanating from the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery, one of Russia's largest oil refineries with an annual crude oil processing capacity of 15 million metric tons.

title: We must return Ukrainian journalists still imprisoned in Russia
summary:
The plight of these journalists is complicated not only by unlawful arrests, but also by the fact that they were detained in Ukraine's temporarily occupied territories.
Russian authorities illegally force Russian citizenship upon them and try them in occupation courts, seeking to sever them from any international legal protection.

title: Cyberattack hits German drone manufacturer supplying Ukraine in late October, company confirms
summary: "Companies at the forefront of supporting Ukraine are being targeted precisely because our work is critically relevant to customers' security," the company said in its official statement.

title: Top security official released on $1.4 million bail in major corruption case
summary: Duka is a suspect in a sweeping investigation by the National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) into scam call centers. The probe led to the ouster of Prosecutor General Ruslan Kravchenko, who fled Ukraine in September, and implicated senior officials in his office.

title: Born to Be Independent: Kyiv Independent launches a new collection for its fifth anniversary
summary: The Kyiv Independent is celebrating its fifth anniversary this month. To mark the occasion, we’re launching a Born to Be Independent collection — for everyone who believes in the freedom to speak their mind. Every purchase supports the Kyiv Independent's journalism in Ukraine.

title: Russia strikes Zaporizhzhia, injures 30, including 6 children
summary: Rescuers freed 14 people who had been trapped in their apartments following the strike, Ukraine's State Emergency Service said.

title: Ukrainian-founded drone maker UForce raises $700 million at $6 billion valuation
summary: The investment will help UForce expand production for Ukraine and supply allied countries with systems suited to modern warfare, the company said.

title: Ukraine seeks explanation on Starshield speed restrictions from US
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Nov. 13 that the restrictions applied over Russian-occupied territory and along the front line, making it "impossible" to use interceptors against Shahed-type drones.

title: Russia's advance in Ukraine has slowed significantly, Air Assault Forces commander says
summary: Heavy casualties are limiting Moscow's ability to sustain its offensive despite its manpower advantage, Maj. Gen. Oleh Apostol, commander of Ukraine's Air Assault Forces, said during a meeting with journalists.

title: Russian attacks kill 9, injure 61 across Ukraine over past day, spark fire at Kyiv hospital
summary: Russian forces launched 117 long-range attack drones, Gerbera and simulator drones at Ukraine overnight on Nov. 13, including 63 jet-powered drones, Ukraine's Air Force said.

title: Prosecutor's office receives order to probe top Zelensky ally but no investigation opened so far
summary: The Anti-Corruption Action Center, an independent watchdog, has lambasted acting Prosecutor General Anton Kovalskyi for refusing to open the investigation so far.

title: Car explosion in Moscow reportedly injures ex-PM press secretary
summary: Zavorotny served as press secretary during the presidency of Viktor Yanukovych in Ukraine and fled to Russia in 2014 after Yanukovych's ouster following the Euromaidan Revolution.
